analysis.call: set.seed(2026) # learner_data is the local CSV data frame analysis_columns <- c("mpg", "cylinder_group") source_rows <- which(complete.cases(learner_data[analysis_columns])) analysis_data <- learner_data[source_rows, analysis_columns, drop = FALSE] labels <- sprintf("observation-%04d", source_rows) analysis_data[["cylinder_group"]] <- factor(analysis_data[["cylinder_group"]]) fit <- aov(reformulate("cylinder_group", response = "mpg"), data = analysis_data) evidence <- as_rlearnxr_evidence(fit, labels = labels)
